title: Add slugify helper to string utilities module
prompt: src/strings.js holds our small string helpers. Add a slugify(input) function and export it alongside the existing helpers. Requirements: normalize unicode with NFKD and strip diacritic combining marks, lowercase the result, convert every run of non-alphanumeric characters (spaces, punctuation, repeats) into a single hyphen, and trim leading and trailing hyphens. Example: 'Creme Brulee!' becomes 'creme-brulee'. Do not change the existing helpers. State a short plan before making changes.
